title: Lab - Installing the VPA
description: Install the Vertical Pod Autoscaler components.
scenario: Install the Vertical Pod Autoscaler components. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Clone and install
tasks.instructions: Install the VPA from the autoscaler repository.
tasks.verification: kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep vpa

tasks.title: Task 2 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: Which three components did it deploy and what does each do?
tasks.solution: kubectl get deploy -n kube-system | grep vpa
